content: प्रतिग्रह् €9 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To hold, seize, take, support; वर्षधरप्रतिगृहीतमेनम् <ls>M. 4</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 48</ls>. .²2 To take, accept, receive; ददाति प्रतिगृह्णाति <ls>Pt. 2</ls>; अमोघाः प्रतिगृह्णन्तावर्ध्यानुपदमाशिषः <ls>R. 1. 44</ls>, <ls n="R.">2. 22</ls>. .²3 To receive or accept as a present. .²4 To receive inimically, oppose, encounter, resist; to attack, assault; प्रतिजग्राह कालिङ्गस्तमस्त्रैर्गजसाधनः <ls>R. 4. 40</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 47</ls>. .²5 To take in marriage, marry; विधिवत् प्रतिगृह्यापि त्यजेत् कन्यां विगर्हिताम् <ls>Ms. 9. 72</ls>. .²6 To obey, conform or listen to. .²7 To resort to, betake oneself to. .²8 To eclipse. .²9 To assent to, admit. .²10 To occupy, take possession of. .²11 To deprive (one) of. .²12 To welcome, receive; प्रत्यगृह्णाद्यथान्यायं विदुरश्च महामनाः <ls>Mb. 14. 66. 6</ls>. .²13 To eat, drink. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to accept, give, present. .²2 To allow to take or retain; मुष्टं प्रतिग्राहयता स्वमर्थं पात्रीकृतो दस्युरिवासि येन <ls>Ś. 5. 20</ls>.
